head_commit.message: [codex] Treat max as a first-class reasoning effort (#30467) ## Why The Bedrock GPT-5.6 catalog advertises `max`, but Codex treated it as an opaque custom effort. That made the reasoning picker render it as lowercase `max` while known efforts use productized labels. Making `max` a known effort aligns catalog data, parsing, and UI presentation without changing the `max` wire value or persisted representation. ## What changed - Add first-class `ReasoningEffort::Max` parsing and serialization. - Use the typed effort in the Bedrock catalog and render it as `Max` in the TUI. - Preserve forward-compatible custom-effort coverage with a genuinely unknown `future` value. ### Before ### After

Making `max` a known effort aligns catalog data, parsing, and UI presentation without changing the `max` wire value or persisted representation. ## What changed - Add first-class `ReasoningEffort::Max` parsing and serialization. - Use the typed effort in the Bedrock catalog and render it as `Max` in the TUI. - Preserve forward-compatible custom-effort coverage with a genuinely unknown `future` value. ### Before ### After
